run_eval_model_cli: run the eval_model CLI to evaluate SAD/OP/OBL Hanabi agents over 5000 games
run_evaluate_agents: run evaluate_agents to compute mean score, SEM, and perfect rate for a list of Hanabi agents
run_sad_model_eval: run the eval_model CLI with --paper sad to evaluate a SAD paper model using a weight file
run_op_model_eval: run the eval_model CLI with --paper op to evaluate an OP paper model by method and index
run_obl_model_eval: run the eval_model CLI with --paper obl to evaluate an OBL model from a given path
